Show list slicing and how to replace a part of a list.

Supplied answer
fruits = ["apple", "orange", "mango", "grapes", "kiwi"]
print(fruits[2]) # mango
print(fruits[1:3]) # ["orange", "mango"]
print(fruits[-1]) # kiwi
print(fruits[:2]) # first two
fruits[1:3] = ["banana", "papaya"] # replace a slice
print(fruits)
del fruits[0] # delete by index
print(fruits)
